rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an individual or organization that makes goods or provides services.

example.english: This producer specializes in making eco-friendly cleaning products.
example.traditional: 呢間生產商專門生產環保清潔用品。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 sang1 caan2 soeng1 zyun1 mun4 sang1 caan2 waan4 bou2 cing1 git3 jung6 ban2

rows.note: Use this broad entertainment term for the person behind a film, show, album, game, or other artistic production.

example.english: The producer of this film said the behind-the-scenes footage will come out next month.
example.traditional: 呢套戲嘅製作人話，拍攝花絮下個月先出。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 zai3 zok3 jan4 waa6 paak3 sip3 faa1 seoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 sin1 ceot1

rows.note: Use this especially for the credited producer or supervising producer of a film or television programme.

example.english: The TV station interviewed the producer of the drama yesterday.
example.traditional: 電視台噚日訪問咗套劇嘅監製。
example.jyutping: din6 si6 toi4 cam4 jat6 fong2 man6 zo2 tou3 kek6 ge3 gaam1 zai3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the producer of a song, album, or other music recording.

example.english: The music producer changed the ending, and the whole song sounds much better now.
example.traditional: 呢首歌嘅音樂製作人改咗個結尾，成首歌好聽咗好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 jam1 ngok6 zai3 zok3 jan4 goi2 zo2 go3 git3 mei5 sing4 sau2 go1 hou2 teng1 zo2 hou2 do1
